_about: Config for audit_inheritance.py (resources/Layer Definition of Done.md, section 8). Stacks below each layer come from the backward chains (steam_layout/chains.py: who adds the layer, back to Base, plus bystanders); 'targets' can add extra stacks (bottom to top, with a why). Optional 'when_inherited' includes a declared stack only when its effective source/input binding comes from the named lower from_layer; local bindings, disabled sources and source-mode changes exclude it. This scopes newly exposed routes without changing frozen builds that still block entry. Decisions for routes that stay open are not kept here any more: they are exceptions to R140 in the exceptions register (steam_layout/flow_config.json). Default-layout names; 'variants' maps them for alternative. Every Always On layer is audited automatically. A source-mode change above a definer blocks inheritance (author, 2026-10-01), so RTP Double Tap's dpad-mode right pad already blocks Base's mouse-mode touch.

stacks.why: 90.47 exposes Base's LST entry after Steering Entry Guard exits. Its short-touch release opens this window over armed Steering; the window must replace Steering's up/down clear with W/S (R140/R141).
The same inherited LST gesture is reachable with persistent Gyro below Steering. Gyro does not block this touch entry.
90.47 exposes Base's RST entry after Steering Entry Guard exits. Its short-touch release opens this window over armed Steering; the window must replace Steering's up/down clear with W/S (R140/R141).
The same inherited RST gesture is reachable with persistent Gyro below Steering. Gyro does not block this touch entry.
